name: Hearth grass carp
summary: Grass carp smoked on the hearth, served beside chẩm chéo and pork belly.
origin: Báo Sơn La, 15 May 2025. Tổ 3, phường Chiềng Cơi.
howToEat: As the smoked fish, or carry it.
where: Phường Chiềng Cơi. No stall is a pick.
seoTitle: Ca tram gac bep in Son La — hearth grass carp
seoDescription: Cá trắm gác bếp in Sơn La, named by Báo Sơn La as a Chiềng Cơi hearth product.
